Practical information The Civic Centre is a ten-minute walk from Saltmarsh station. Badges must be worn at all times inside the venue.
Cloakroom on the ground floor, open from 08:00 to 18:00
Quiet room for prayer and rest on the first floor, next to Room 2
Step-free access through the east entrance on Harbour Road
Free drinking water at every landing
Registration fees

How to book a workshop
1) Sign in to the members area with your conference number.
2) Choose one workshop per day from the Studio 3 list.
3) Bring the confirmation e-mail to the registration desk.
